protocol: card 13 in IDEA_DESK_B_NOV11.md; a protocol file is written and committed before this job runs
status: NOT YET APPROVED; proposed as the next and last cheap read
purpose: settled daily approval markets and their rules text, to test whether a poll table rebuilt from Wikipedia reproduces Kalshi's settled value (kill: under 80% of days within 0.3 points). No price is read.
auth: none (public market data; no key, no header, no cookie)
on_429: wait 300 seconds and resume; stop the job for good at 5 refusals; never loop
writes: only the output folder on a data branch; never main; no Firestore; nothing under functions/
drop_fields: volume (no price is to be read in this job)
heldout_rule: markets closing in the last third of event dates are listed but flagged heldout; their results are not used in the proxy fit
